component.name: ZeppBridge
ZeppBridge
component.summary: Your Zepp data, handed back to you
把你的 Zepp 数据交回给你

description.p: ZeppBridge is a local-first desktop companion for Amazfit and Zepp wearables. It syncs your health records out of the Zepp cloud into a single SQLite file on your own machine, and lets you read, archive and export them without going through a phone.

ul.li: Long-term trends for heart rate, sleep, workouts, recovery, stress and SpO₂.
Backfills history from before you installed it, month by month, pausable and resumable.
Whole-database backups with checksums, and a record-count diff before any restore.
Exports to JSON, CSV and GPX.
Ships a non-interactive CLI and a read-only MCP server for scripts and local models.

description.p: It does not prettify data. A day you did not wear the watch is a gap in the chart, and a metric your watch never measured reads "not provided" rather than zero.
ZeppBridge is an independent, unofficial project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Zepp Health, Huami or Amazfit.
ZeppBridge 是一个本地优先的桌面伴侣程序，面向 Amazfit / Zepp 手表和手环。 它把你的健康记录从 Zepp 云同步到本机的一个 SQLite 文件里，让你不必通过 手机就能查看、归档和导出这些数据。
它不会美化数据：没戴表的那天，图上就是一个缺口；手表从未测量过的指标 显示「未提供」，而不是 0。
本项目是独立的非官方开源项目，与 Zepp Health、华米、Amazfit 无关。
